authority: Physical user measurements and screw-fit test on the final display module.

mounting_architecture.decision: Mount the Pajoniiir-M1 custom mainboard directly to the four inner threaded posts on the rear of the DSI506 display.
mounting_architecture.display_facing_side_policy: Keep substantially component-free; only deliberately validated low-profile parts such as the DSI host receptacle may be placed on this side.

mount_pattern.coordinate_system: display rear PCB top-left origin; +X right; +Y down

screw_hardware.recommended_head_style: pan-head or low-profile machine screw; exact head diameter/washer decision remains mechanical-detail work
screw_hardware.m2p5x5_policy: DO_NOT_USE_WITH_1P6MM_BARE_PCB_BASELINE__nominal engagement would be 3.4 mm against only 3.0 mm measured usable depth
screw_hardware.washer_policy: If a washer is added, re-check remaining thread engagement before production lock.

pcb_mounting_holes.copper_keepout_policy: No copper beneath screw head/bearing region; exact keepout diameter to be finalized with screw-head/washer selection.

ffc_context.routing_concept: Controlled U-bend near right edge to a display-facing host receptacle on the directly mounted mainboard.
